title: RERR signature enforcement gap enables route deletion attacks
description: Unlike RREP which has receive_rrep (line 338) enforcing signature presence at the API level, RERR parsing provides no equivalent validation helper. Callers using Rerr::from_bytes() must remember to manually check signature.is_some() before processing route invalidations. Add a require_signature() or receive_rerr() helper method.
close_reason: Fixed: Added require_signature() helper method to Rerr struct (lines 614-640 in loadng.rs) that enforces signature presence at the API level, mirroring the protection that receive_rrep provides for RREP. This prevents route deletion attacks by ensuring callers can chain Rerr::from_bytes()?.require_signature()? for safe RERR processing. Added 3 tests verifying the method accepts signed REERRs, rejects unsigned REERRs, and integrates with the from_bytes() API pattern.
